_comment: Remittance Advice Remark Codes (RARC) - the payer's specific reason. Grows with every EOB we see.
N290: Missing/incomplete/invalid rendering provider identifier - fix rendering NPI and resubmit
N30: Patient ineligible for this service - verify eligibility/benefit for DOS
M76: Missing/incomplete/invalid diagnosis - correct ICD-10 and resubmit
M127: Missing patient medical record for this service - send records (fast money)
N179: Additional information requested from member - patient must respond to payer; follow up with patient
N479: Missing Explanation of Benefits (primary payer EOB) - attach primary EOB, resubmit
N522: Duplicate of a claim processed/adjudicated - verify true duplicate before writing off
N56: Procedure code billed is not correct/valid for the services billed - recode
N115: Decision based on Local Coverage Determination (LCD) - review LCD, appeal with criteria met
N54: Claim information inconsistent with pre-certified/authorized services - match claim to auth details
M62: Missing/incomplete/invalid treatment authorization code - add auth number, resubmit
